title: Policy
description: A brig policy document: egress rules, brokered routes and MCP servers. api/policy/v1alpha1 is the reader; this schema is for editors. Egress and routes are typed loosely here, and the validator is the authority on them.

mcp.description: MCP servers the guest may call through the broker. Names are unique within the policy.

mcpServer.description: One MCP server behind the broker. Either a preset with a credential, or a full definition with url, credential and inject.

name.description: Unique within the policy. Follows the route name grammar, and is not brig-memory.

preset.description: A ready-made server. It fills transport, url and inject, so a server that names one sets none of them.

transport.description: How the broker reaches the server. Only http so far.

url.description: The https:// MCP endpoint, with no user name, password, query or fragment.

credential.description: The secret that inject sends upstream. It is never delivered to the guest.

inject.description: How the credential reaches the upstream. Only inject.headers is accepted.

allow.description: Tool names matched exactly, or "*" for every tool.
